_readme: Answer key for tests/fixtures/touch-target-tiers.json. Written from the fixture, not from script output: every `basis` names the fixture values the expectation comes from. The pass bar is 44x44 (2.5.5, AAA); meetsAA is the 24x24 floor of 2.5.8 (AA, WCAG 2.2), judged on the shorter side of the State=Default variant. One entry per component set, because the script audits one set per call.

checks.basis: Checks run in a fixed order: contrast (index 0), touch target (1), font size (2), focus (3); touch target and focus only for interactive names. The check names both criteria it reports against.
Both sides are 44, the pass bar.
The shorter side, 44, is at least 24.
State=Default is 44x44: the details give the measured size and the tier reached.
Checks run in a fixed order: contrast (index 0), touch target (1), font size (2), focus (3); touch target and focus only for interactive names. The check names both criteria it reports against.
32 is at least 24, so AA is met although the check fails.
State=Default is 32x32: the details give the measured size and the tier reached.
checks.expect: 32×32px, meets 2.5.8 AA (24×24, WCAG 2.2) only, below the 44×44 bar

checks.basis: Checks run in a fixed order: contrast (index 0), touch target (1), font size (2), focus (3); touch target and focus only for interactive names. The check names both criteria it reports against.
The shorter side, 20, is below the 44 pass bar.
The shorter side, 20, is below 24; the 48 width does not make up for it.
State=Default is 48x20: the details give the measured size and the tier reached.
Card holds no interactive keyword, so only contrast and font size run, whatever its 20x20 size.
The second check of a non-interactive set is font size, not touch target.
